zh.title: 聯合航空2027年取消27條國際航線波音737 MAX執飛 六大樞紐皆受影響
zh.summary: 根據Cirium班表資料，聯合航空比對2027年與2026年班表後，將波音737 MAX撤出27條國際航線，分布於六大樞紐；休士頓受影響最大，共8條航線，芝加哥4條，洛杉磯與舊金山各3條，紐瓦克2條。
body: 聯合航空是波音737 MAX家族的主要營運業者之一，根據ch-aviation機隊資料，目前擁有123架737 MAX 8與188架737 MAX 9，未來還將接收35架737 MAX 9。比對Cirium航空分析資料中的2027年與2026年班表後，聯合航空已將737 MAX撤出27條國際航線，分布於美國六大樞紐：東岸兩個、中部兩個、西岸兩個。
東岸方面，紐瓦克失去飛往千里達皮亞科與溫哥華的MAX航班；杜勒斯失去飛往溫哥華、卡加立與多倫多的MAX航班；此外，東岸飛往巴貝多、哥斯大黎加利比瑞亞與拿索的MAX航班也將停飛。中部方面，芝加哥歐海爾失去4條航線，包括飛往蒙特婁與溫哥華，以及貝里斯市與拿索；休士頓受影響最大，共8條航線，包括卡加立、多倫多、科蘇梅爾、聖荷西德卡波與巴亞爾塔港，以及波奈爾島克拉倫代克、大開曼喬治城與聖多明哥。

西岸方面，洛杉磯失去飛往巴亞爾塔港、多倫多與溫哥華的MAX航班；舊金山失去飛往溫哥華、卡加立與巴拿馬市托庫門的MAX航班。不過聯合航空在西岸仍保留相當規模的MAX飛航：截至2027年10月的12個月內，舊金山計畫執行26,868班MAX航班，洛杉磯為11,132班。聯合航空737 MAX 9設有20個國內頭等／商務艙座位與159個經濟艙座位，其中45或48個經濟艙座位具加大腿部空間；較小的737 MAX 8則設有16個國內頭等／商務艙座位與150個經濟艙座位，其中54個具加大腿部空間。

en.title: United Airlines takes Boeing 737 MAX off 27 international routes in 2027
en.summary: United Airlines has removed the Boeing 737 MAX from 27 international routes in its 2027 schedules compared with 2026, according to Cirium schedule data, with the cuts spread across six US hubs. Houston is the most affected with eight routes, followed by Chicago with four, and Los Angeles and San Francisco with three each.
body: United Airlines is one of the world's largest operators of the Boeing 737 MAX family, with fleet data from ch-aviation showing it currently has 123 737 MAX 8s and 188 737 MAX 9s, and 35 more 737 MAX 9s still to be delivered as its mainline fleet modernises. Comparing the airline's 2027 schedules with those for 2026, using data from Cirium, an aviation analytics company, United has taken the MAX off no fewer than 27 international routes, spread across six hubs: two on the East Coast, two on the West Coast and two in the centre of the US.

On the East Coast, Newark has lost MAX flights on just two international routes, to Piarco International Airport in Trinidad and to Vancouver in Canada. From Washington Dulles, Vancouver is one of three Canadian destinations to lose United MAX flights, along with Calgary and Toronto Pearson, while MAX flights to Barbados, Liberia in Costa Rica and Nassau in the Caribbean are also ending. In the centre of the country, Chicago O'Hare has lost four routes — Montreal, Vancouver, Belize City and Nassau — and Houston, the most affected hub, has lost eight: Calgary and Toronto, the Mexican destinations of Cozumel, San Jose del Cabo and Puerto Vallarta, and the Caribbean destinations of Kralendijk on Bonaire, George Town on Grand Cayman and Santo Domingo.

On the West Coast, Los Angeles has lost MAX flights to Puerto Vallarta, Toronto Pearson and Vancouver, while San Francisco has lost Vancouver, Calgary and Panama City's Tocumen International Airport. United will still retain considerable MAX networks from both West Coast hubs: in the 12 months to October 2027 it has planned 26,868 MAX flights from San Francisco and 11,132 from Los Angeles. United's MAX 9s have 20 domestic first/business class recliners and 159 economy seats (45 or 48 with extra legroom), while the smaller MAX 8 seats 16 in domestic first/business class and 150 in economy (54 with extra legroom).
